Proves AR-6's `in` operator on a `date` field (AR-7), via the Set Filter wire shape (`{filterType:'set', values:[...]}`), each wire string coerced once into the field's declared type (SEM-5); SEM-2: `in` never matches null. Per SQL-4 Postgres casts the set array, `"birth_date" = ANY($1::date[])`, because `date = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). Dates are local calendar dates with no zone (SEM-4): the neighbours one day either side of a member are not members.
